svg.title: The best quadratic approximation and a local magnification
svg.desc: Overview of sqrt(x), its tangent and its quadratic Taylor polynomial at (9,3), with a second panel magnifying 7.5 ≤ x ≤ 10.5. The blue and green curves nearly coincide in the local view.
svg.metadata: Curves generated with GeoGebra Classic JavaScript API; see scripts/generate-landau-figures.cjs.

g.text: The quadratic (green, dashed) almost overlaps √x (blue); the tangent (orange) separates more visibly.
